newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's King Hussein in hospital for knee treatment.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein in hospital for knee treatment.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan went into hospital on Saturday night for treatment to a painful knee, a palace official said on Sunday.
The official said King Hussein, 61, who returned from a pilgrimage to Mecca on Friday, was expected to leave hospital later on Sunday.
The official Petra news agency quoted King Hussein's private doctor Samir Farraj as saying the king would have a piece of cartilage removed from his left knee.
